en: A vertically oriented vintage postcard printed in sepia tones. The upper two‑thirds are filled with an illustration and long poem in Estonian. At the top is a decorative drawing of a rural landscape with a cross and distant fields or a valley. The title of the poem reads "Tallinnä turul," followed by a subtitle referencing 16. oktoobri langenute mälestuseks (in memory of those fallen on 16 October). The poem is set in two columns with small floral and grain stalk ornaments between them. At the bottom is a monochrome photograph showing a square or street scene in a European city, featuring a tall ornate lamppost in the center, bare trees, and multi‑story buildings in the background; a couple of people stand near the lamppost. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century commemorative postcard.
